tagline: Run Caine's five Adventures and cash in a reward for every one

featuredCards.title: Welcome to the Amazing Digital Circus!
featuredCards.caption: Move both fighters, patch someone up, dig for the right card. The turn you spend lining up today's Adventure.

featuredCards.title: Team Bad Guys
featuredCards.caption: Win or lose, keep Pomni and Jax side by side and this fight splashes two damage around the target's zone. The duo plays best as a pair.

featuredCards.title: Fear not, my skibidi sigmas!
featuredCards.caption: A defence that wipes out the other card's effects, then grows a point for every Adventure you've finished.

featuredCards.title: ricochet super move
featuredCards.caption: The cash-out. A 3 that climbs with every completed Adventure, so a full run fires it as an 8. One shot, then it's gone.
